title: Graph Traversal: BFS & DFS
description: Demonstrates depth-first traversal with an adjacency matrix and breadth-first traversal with an adjacency list.

title: Binary Search Tree
description: Implements insertion, search, deletion, and inorder, preorder, and postorder traversals for a binary search tree.

title: Hash Table with Chaining
description: Implements a hash table with key-value pairs, collision handling through chaining, and insert, search, delete, and display operations.

title: Library Borrowing Analysis
description: Analyzes sample library borrowing records to calculate average borrowing, most and least borrowed books, and zero-borrowing members.

title: Hash Table with Linear Probing
description: Implements insertion, searching, deletion markers, and display for a hash table using linear probing.

title: Event Processing Queue
description: Uses a queue to add, process, list, and cancel pending events through a menu-driven interface.

title: Linear & Binary Search
description: Compares linear and binary search for customer account IDs, sorting the list before binary search.

title: Student Records with a Singly Linked List
description: Manages student records in a singly linked list with add, delete, update, search, and sorted display operations.

title: Selection & Bubble Sort
description: Sorts sample employee salaries using selection sort and bubble sort, then displays the five highest salaries.

title: Text Editor Undo/Redo Stack
description: Models text editing with undo and redo stacks, displaying the document state as changes are made.
